explanation: Compute horizontal and vertical interval intersections using 64-bit endpoints, widening before adding each origin and extent. A strict gap on either axis returns (0,0,-1,-1). Equal endpoints retain a zero-sized touching edge. Convert the resulting origin and extents back to the published int-valued rectangle.
